title: MS/TP: Use common CRC16-CCITT function
description:
The data CRC in MS/TP is a standard CRC16-CCITT. Use our common
function, which is about twice as fast as the implementation copied
from the sample code in the BACNet spec. (Possibly simply because
of making one tvb_get_ptr call instead of many tvb_get_uint8 calls.)

Verified with the mstip_demo.cap file in #3932 to have no change in
calculated CRC.

Also, ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 135-2016 9.3 MS/TP Frame Format indicates
that the 16-bit "Data CRC (present only if... frame is a non-encoded type)"
and that the extended data frame format does not contain the 16-bit
CRC, only an (encoded) CRC-32K. Note that the current implementation is
not actually calculating the 16-bit checksum, merely "verifying" two
encoded bytes against themselves. Don't falsely add these encoded payload
bytes as a checksum.
